note: B captures the 2" x 8" deck frame and states the A6 'LANDSCAPE FOOTING 18"' size as a plain dimension, whereas A omits the frame and turns the 18" callout into an unsupported 'depth'. Both bind the 1" to 'nut sleeve' even though the text layer separates '1" NUT' and 'SLEVE', and both repeat the joist and reclaimed-wood facts. B's extra coverage is partly offset by two misbound claims (4 1/4" as a 'component width' and 1'-0" as the C1 plan's 'overall depth'), so the margin is small.
remarks: Both sets bind '1"' to 'nut sleeve' although the text layer lists '1" NUT' and 'SLEVE' as separate items; the 1" belongs to the nut. Both omit the A6 hardware/post facts (3/4" THREADED ROD, 1" NUT, SLEVE, 4X4 TO BE CUT AS NEEDED, 8'-0") and the 3 3/4"/1 1/4" footing dimensions. The 4 1/4" values in A6 appear twice and their target component is ambiguous in the text layer, so any claim binding them needs an explicit component. Generic quotes such as '1'-0"' occur in several details (C1 and A6) and do not by themselves identify which dimension is meant.
